title: Learning Happiness
coreMove: Locate the desire or comparison disturbing your peace and release the demand that reality change first.
sourcePressure: The source treats happiness as learned, personal, and close to peace. It says happiness appears when nothing feels missing, desire creates chosen unhappiness, presence beats past and future mental motion, envy poisons peace, and habits can raise the baseline over time.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: The wrong version tells readers to think positively, be grateful, meditate, or choose happiness on command. This chapter must show peace as the result of seeing and dropping the demand creating mental motion.

counterintuition: success does not make you happy
tryThisNow: write three things you are grateful for

exampleSpecs.domain: orchard owner waiting for a late frost report before opening the spring market
exampleSpecs.audience: a small grower whose mind keeps running ahead to ruined blossoms and lost revenue
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether one uncertain weather report consumes the only quiet evening before dawn inspection
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she folds the frost printout, names the exact demand that the temperature be different, and returns to oiling the pruning shears because the trees cannot be changed tonight
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A frost advisory printout lies under a pair of oiled pruning shears.

exampleSpecs.domain: orchestra understudy sitting backstage while another violinist takes the solo
exampleSpecs.audience: a musician whose envy turns a beautiful performance into proof of personal lack
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether comparison destroys the exact music she once loved
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she stops counting the soloist's mistakes, feels the envy as a wish to be onstage, and follows the next phrase as sound rather than a verdict on her life
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A spare violin bow rests across a black backstage chair.

exampleSpecs.domain: customs inspector stuck at a closed border lane after a system outage
exampleSpecs.audience: a shift lead whose irritation comes from needing the queue to move now
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether a delay becomes two hours of suffering on top of the delay itself
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: before snapping at the driver, he sees the demand in his head, places the stamp pad back on the counter, and chooses the next actual task he can do
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A dry entry stamp sits beside a dark customs terminal.

exampleSpecs.domain: field biologist whose tagged whale does not surface during the grant team's live tracking window
exampleSpecs.audience: a researcher watching uncertainty become self-attack
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether one missing ping turns into a story that her whole project is failing
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she points to the blank interval on the tracking chart, separates the missing whale from the thought that she is missing her career, and waits for the next scheduled sweep
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A blank blue tracking chart blinks where a whale tag should report.

exampleSpecs.domain: restorer watching a centuries-old pigment flake after weeks of careful stabilization
exampleSpecs.audience: a conservator who wants the object to obey her effort
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether a single flake becomes evidence that reality owes her permanence
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she records the flake in the condition log without adding blame, then labels the desire for the surface to stay unchanged as the source of the extra pain
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A fleck of blue pigment sits on a square of acid-free tissue.

exampleSpecs.domain: amateur chess finalist replaying the lost position before the trophy ceremony
exampleSpecs.audience: a competitor whose mind keeps trying to reopen a move that no longer exists
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the next hour is lived as presence or as imaginary repair of an ended game
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: when a friend asks what he is analyzing, he turns over the captured knight, says the game is gone, and watches the final match being packed away
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A black knight lies on its side beside a folded pairing sheet.

skillTargets: identify the specific desire or comparison producing mental motion
distinguish acceptance from passivity in an uncontrollable moment
choose presence over replaying past or rehearsing future
analyze why success or possession cannot secure peace while desire keeps moving
evaluate happiness habits by whether they lower noise rather than chase stimulation

tryThisNowSpec: Name the one thing you currently need reality to do before you can be at peace. Say plainly whether you can act on it in the next minute. If not, put one object in order and let the demand sit unanswered.

sourceAnchors.name: Tao Te Ching
sourceAnchors.detail: the source invokes the Tao Te Ching while explaining duality: every positive thought carries contrast with a negative one
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The Tao Te Ching enters as a warning against clinging even to positive thoughts, because contrast keeps the mind moving.

sourceAnchors.name: Jerzy Gregorek
sourceAnchors.detail: the source presents Jerzy Gregorek as someone at peace and healthy, not dependent on comparison or external validation
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Jerzy Gregorek becomes the anti-status example: peace looks like needing less from the scoreboard.

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: prevents the timestamp+named-protagonist template from dominating the chapter

rhythmVariety.deepReadParagraphLengthMix: at least one paragraph 3 sentences or shorter, at least one 5+ sentences, at least one one-sentence punch line
rhythmVariety.fullReadInterludeRequirement: at least one paragraph that breaks the scene-then-rule rhythm — a question to the reader, a research aside, a direct second-person passage, or a brief historical reference
rhythmVariety.forbiddenRhythm: every paragraph following 'concrete anchor -> abstract rule -> elaboration'
